title: "Baby Names"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
files <- fs::dir_ls("data", glob = "*yob*.txt")
baby_names <- read_csv(files, id = "file", col_names = c("name", "sex", "count")) |>
  mutate(year = parse_number(basename(file)))
```

```{r}
#| label: javier-trend
javier <- baby_names |>
  filter(name == "Javier", sex == "M") |>
  filter(year >= max(year) - 99)

ggplot(javier, aes(x = year, y = count)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name Javier (Past 100 Years)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    caption = "Source: Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Over the last 100 years (1926–2025), the name Javier grew steadily from under 20 births per year in the late 1920s to a peak of 2,637 in 2001, before declining to 1,252 in 2025.
